description: Java interface defining the service layer for managing notes, including methods for CRUD operations.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Interface providing methods for managing notes within the application.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, if it exists.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note based on the provided request data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with data from the request.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, returning true if successful.
